newsitem.title: ISRAEL: PLO policeman kills prisoner trying to flee.
newsitem.headline: PLO policeman kills prisoner trying to flee.

text.p: A PLO policeman shot dead a Palestinian prisoner who was trying to break out of a jail in self-ruled Jericho, a security official said on Wednesday.

"Rashid Fityani, 21, who was arrested in 1994 on charges of collaborating with Israel, was shot by a policeman during a fight, and the policeman was jailed for killing the man," said the official who declined to be identified.
He said the fight broke out on Tuesday when Fityani tried to escape. A Jericho hospital source said Fityani's body was taken to hospital.

A statement issued by the Palestinian National Forces in Jericho, read by security official Hassan Saleh, said: "During the fight, which developed into a fist fight, Fityani, who was outside his prison cell, beat up the soldier which led to the shooting and the death of Fityani."
"The Palestinian National Forces regrets such an unfortunate incident and will take the necessary legal measures against the soldier," the statement said.
Khader Shqaira, director of the Palestinian society for human rights, and previously Fityani's lawyer, criticised the Palestinian Authority for not providing protection for prisoners.

"This prisoner and others have been tortured...and Amnesty International had issued a report a few days ago asking the Palestinian Authority to refrain from using force against detainees in its jails," Shqair said.
Reporters said they were prevented by Palestinian police from taking pictures of Fityani's body in Jericho hospital.

Palestinian police took over Jericho and the Gaza Strip in May 1994 under an interim peace deal with Israel. After the takeover, PLO police jailed without trial several Palestinians suspected of collaborating with Israel.
